name: Revolting Cocks

albums.title: Linger Ficken’ Good… and Other Barnyard Oddities

intro: Revolting Cocks, also known as RevCo, are an American-Belgian industrial rock band, and sometimes supergroup, that began as a musical side project for Richard 23 of Front 242, Luc van Acker, and Al Jourgensen of Ministry.
